verdict.rationale: Inngest has no native natural-language interface, but its official MCP server lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or another MCP client 'inspect and operate Inngest from your coding agent.' Its CLI is also designed to give coding agents access to run data and to invoke functions. Natural-language operation therefore works only through a third-party agent, and the docs only imply the scope of what can be operated this way. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface in the dashboard or CLI, documentation of which operations work through natural-language prompts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven operation.
